mapper.select: select user_id, request_id, request_hash, status, result_json from ai_theme_draft_request where user_id = #{userId} and request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.insert: insert into ai_theme_draft_request (user_id, request_id, request_hash, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{requestId}, #{requestHash}, 'PROCESSING', now(), now())
mapper.update: update ai_theme_draft_request set status = #{status}, result_json = #{resultJson}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and request_id = #{requestId} and request_hash = #{requestHash} and status = 'PROCESSING'
